openclaw_image_drift.patch_purpose: Installs `grammy@^1.42.0` on top of openclaw:tagai-pre-grammy → produces openclaw:tagai-grammy. `grammy` is the Telegram Bot framework. This patch fixed the 7-day Telegram crash-loop noted in MEMORY.md session log 2026-05-07.

FROM openclaw:tagai-pre-grammy
USER node
WORKDIR /app
RUN npm install grammy@^1.42.0 --no-save --no-package-lock --omit=dev --legacy-peer-deps && test -f /app/node_modules/grammy/package.json && node -e "console.log('grammy installed:', require('/app/node_modules/grammy/package.json').version)"
